headline: South African Officials Blamed as US Moves to Suspend Trade Benefits Under AGOA
summary: Labor and legal groups blamed South African President Cyril Ramaphosa and International Relations Minister Ronald Lamola following moves by the US to suspend South Africa from the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA).
why: AGOA provides eligible sub-Saharan African nations with duty-free access to the US market, supporting local export industries, manufacturing employment, and bilateral trade revenues.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Loss of trade preferences under AGOA impacts South African export competitiveness.
